## Bio

I am a Reader in Economics at Aston Business School and Centre Director of
the [Centre for Business Prosperity](https://www.aston.ac.uk/research/bss/research-centres/business-prosperity),
and Former Lead Economist at the [Foreign Trade Research Center (Trade+)](https://kse.ua/kse-impact/trade/) at
the Kyiv School of Economics. I hold a PhD in Economics from the
University of Maryland.

My research is applied international economics: how firms, industries, and
countries grow by integrating into global markets, and what happens to that
growth when integration goes into reverse — through Brexit, trade wars, or
war itself. Current work spans UK services trade after Brexit, the trade
effects of geopolitical alignment, and Ukraine's wartime export economy.

Alongside academic research, I advise governments, firms, and institutions
on trade policy — see [Consultancy](/consultancy/index.qmd).
